items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The YMCA has this wire and it was a wire from Jimmie Lunceford. Said would you like to join my band? ... So I immediately went to the telephone and called Jimmie Lunceford. ctx.x: What was your musical start from?

Well it was kind of like Snooky. My mother was a pianist. She played the piano, she played in the church and also played in the school. She was a school teacher in a little town in Mississippi, Shelby. And she started me out teaching me piano when I was about six. However, I didn’t take too well with the piano at that time because my sister was an excellent classical pianist. My mother could play the piano and my brother could even play the piano.
